'''Shield Actuators''' were components used in [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]]. Both the [[Chempat Shield Generator]] and [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards']] [[ISD-72x deflector shield generator dome]] utilized Shield Actuators in their design.<ref name="EGWT" />
